releases.summary: Deletes the obsolete pre-SLM2 native implementation and enforces one clean-slate catalog and source authority.
changes: Deleted the former Rust CLI, v0 fixtures, tracked single-file model demo, and stale cross-checkout runtime dependency from current source.
Added a repository gate that rejects reintroduction of retired native surfaces and verifies the fail-closed single-source-authority policy.
Kept the current SLM2 composition catalog and peer feed truthfully empty with no hosted model artifacts.
Documented that a future native companion must start from the six-member SLM2 contract without a legacy reader or fallback.

releases.summary: Replaces obsolete single-file catalog routes with the sole clean-slate six-member SLM2 catalog and explicit acquisition contract.
changes: Published strict SLM2 composition and peer-announcement metadata schemas with truthful empty current feeds.
Published one visible exact-peer-or-pinned-local-conversion acquisition flow without instruction-file or remote-inference fallback.
Documented the two separate authorized MemoryEndpoints uses and their identity, credential, consent, scope, provenance, and receipt separation.
Retired former manifest-v0, peer-offer, fixture, and single-file model catalog routes.

releases.summary: Historical first metadata-only catalog release; superseded by the clean-slate SLM2 release.
changes: Published the former metadata-only catalog and deterministic release history.
Excluded model bytes from the hosted closure.
Retained here only as immutable publication history, not current format or compatibility authority.
